newsitem.title: USA: Pacer sees earnings boost from vendor pact.
newsitem.headline: Pacer sees earnings boost from vendor pact.

text.p: Pacer Technology, owner of branded products such as Super Glue, said Wednesday it expects earnings and revenues to grow as a result of its selection as Home Depot Inc's exclusive vendor of record for carded adhesives.

Pacer, owner of branded products such as Super Glue, said it will supply all carded adhesives to 115 of Home Depot's 542 stores and has the right to supply 500 additional stores that Home Depot plans to add by the year 2000.
"As a result, Pacer expects to generate a substantial increase in revenues over the next three years. These revenues will increase earnings materially during the same period," Pacer said.
